summary: Ryan Albert was last seen Oct 4 near Granite Pass heading toward the Keyhole; a 28-day search amid severe weather was suspended; his body was found under deep snow in The Trough in May 2019 and recovered by helicopter
notes: Body discovered by climbing rangers in May 2019 under deep snow; helicopter recovery; cause of death not stated in opened sources MERGE run 628: NPT "Albert SAR put on hold due to winter" article URL appended (parent-opened — Ryan Albert, 30, Marlton NJ, last seen Oct 4 near Granite Pass heading toward the Keyhole; documents the Oct–Nov 2018 search and winter suspension). MERGE run 633: CPR 2019-05-31 recovery report (parent-opened) — body believed to be Ryan Albert found Thursday 2019-05-30 in deep snow in the Trough ~1,000 ft below the Ledges, ~2,000 ft below the summit; recovered by helicopter Friday 2019-05-31; Boulder County Coroner to provide positive ID. Body recovered 2019-05-30 in The Trough via helicopter (CPR 2019-05-31).
